slides.texte_overlay:
The Sunday routine of
men who win the week

1. Plan the week
in 15 minutes

Three priorities. Not ten.

2. Cook for three days

Monday you will thank
Sunday you.

3. Reset your room

Clean sheets. Clear desk.
Calm space, calm head.

4. Call your family

Ten minutes. No reason needed.

5. Long walk, no phone

Let the week settle
before the next one starts.

6. Learn one new thing

Start Monday with a
sharper head than Friday.
